architecture.css_design_system: body { background: #0b0f19; color: #e2e8f0; font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; min-height: 100vh; padding: 24px; } .rack-container { background: #161e2e; border: 2px solid #2d3748; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; width: 100%; max-width: 800px; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); } .dial-rack { display: flex; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .piano-keyboard { display: flex; height: 160px; position: relative; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #111; } .key-white { flex: 1; background: #fff; border-right: 1px solid #ccc; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.1s; } .key-white:active, .key-white.active { background: #60a5fa; }
architecture.js_state_machine: let audioCtx = null; function getAudioContext() { if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); return audioCtx; } function playTone(freq) { const ctx = getAudioContext(); const osc = ctx.createOscillator(); const gain = ctx.createGain(); osc.type = document.getElementById('waveSelect').value; osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime); gain.gain.setValueAtTime(parseFloat(document.getElementById('volSlider').value), ctx.currentTime); gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.6); osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination); osc.start(); osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.6); }
